ModMetaData.name: Adaptive Storage Neolithic Renew - Pickle tests
ModMetaData.author: Nelim
ModMetaData.description:
In-game functional tests for Adaptive Storage Neolithic Renew, run by Pickle. Development only: never published.
The scenarios build the mod's containers on the Pickle test colony and spawn items into them. Scenarios tagged @review assert nothing about the image: they attach screenshots for a person to judge, because whether a basket visibly fills up, or a stack of chunks swaps its sprite at one, two and six chunks, is a judgement about a picture.
One feature is tagged @wip and only makes sense in a French game: run the suite a second time with the language set to French.
